# Firing handbook revision B

Historical edition; replaced by [revision C](firing-handbook.md). It is not current operating authority.

## Cooling release
This retired edition allowed opening after a single controller display reached 84 synthetic degrees, with no timed independent-probe check. Old journals bearing code B should be interpreted against that historical convention, not relabelled as revision C checks.

## Archive use
Keep this sheet attached to old training exercises. Do not use it to fill missing observations in a current run.
